x: In an Invitation Continental Relay we finished second to Polytechnic; our team of Leroy, Eldridge, Newell T., and Tolson recording 1:58.2 to Poly.'s 1:57.9.

Morris, Eldridge and Leroy, you will soon have to face opposition from within. Edwin Hawkins was another to excel in the London Schools' Championships, finishing 2nd in the Long Jump, and thus gaining his London badge.
Smithers and Leroy had a private battle in the Long Jump with Mike just beating his less experienced rival by the odd half-inch (19'6½" to 19'6").
Leroy ran his usual couple of 'stormers' to collect two seconds, clocking 22.8 in the furlong and 49.6 in the 440 yds behind international half-miler Mike Fleet of Croydon.
August some of the boys went down to Brighton. Leroy clocked 22.9 in the 220 yds and 49.4 in the 440 yards, Thresher 4:15.3 in the Senior mile, and Bicourt 4:29.6 in the Junior mile.
